items.Sentence: The WWTF consists of a gravity collection system, a 9,000-gallon temporary storage/holding tank, a sewage distribution box, and two unlined percolation/evaporation ponds as shown on Attachment B, which is attached hereto and made part of the Order by reference.
Wastewater is concentrated through evaporation, and infiltrates into the bottom soils of the ponds.
The Discharger’s self-monitoring reports indicate that the dissolved oxygen concentrations in the raw sewage evaporation/percolation ponds have ranged from 0.6 to 18.2 mg/L.
The Discharger’s sanitary sewer system component of the WWTF collects wastewater using sewers, pipes, pumps, and/or other conveyance systems and directs this raw sewage to the unlined ponds.
